outcome: Control of severe atonic postpartum hemorrhage
Complications related to the suture method
cohort: Nine women experiencing heavy postpartum bleeding from uterine inertia and placenta previa percreta during cesarean delivery, unresponsive to conventional management protocols, were included.
finding: The symbol '&' compression suture technique immediately stanched postpartum hemorrhage in all nine women with no reported complications.
mod_finding: The symbol '&' compression suture technique is specifically applied during cesarean delivery to control postpartum hemorrhage.
